market_summary: Wed Nov 25: S&P 500 -0.25% to 7,182.78 and Nasdaq -0.62% to 23,585.80 after being down 3.2% and 4.6% intraday on AI-spend fears; semis down over 6% at the lows, Nvidia -3.9%; 10-year down about 7bp to 4.82%; VIX +7% to 28.3. Core PCE ran 3.3% y/y, slightly hot, and CME FedWatch prices about 98% odds of a 25bp hike on Dec 9. The White House proposed new tariffs of up to 20% on China, the EU and 12 other partners, stacking on existing rates, likely from January as the China truce ends Jan 10. Oil near $84 with Hormuz risk still in play. Thu Nov 26 Asia bounced while the US is shut for Thanksgiving: Nikkei about +1.2-1.6%, Kospi +1.5% after a 6% drop, Hang Seng +1.5-1.9%, ASX 200 flat; Bank of Korea hiked to 3.25%.

AMZN.reason: Closed down 3.1% Wed as AI capex doubts and record tech credit spreads hit megacaps; no company news.

AXOS.reason: Flat Wed (-0.1%); forward PE under 9, but a December hike now near-certain keeps funding costs high.

BABA.reason: Up 1.7% Wed in US; Hong Kong shares up about 3% Thu as Hang Seng rose about 2% to end a 7-day slide. New 20% Section 301 tariff proposal on China is the risk.

ENPH.reason: Up 2.4% Wed against the tape; proposed Section 301 tariffs on 14 partners could raise solar supply costs.

FIGR.reason: Closed up 5.6% Wed despite the tech rout; no company news.

GOOGL.reason: Closed down 2.1% Wed after Nasdaq clawed back from a 4.6% drop to -0.6%; Google CDS hit a record high. Up 0.7% after hours.

LDI.reason: Up 18% Wed on no clear news; penny-stock swings while 98% December hike odds weigh on mortgage volumes.

META.reason: Up 3.4% Wed, best of the megacaps as the AI selloff rotated away from capex-heavy names; no company news.

MRVL.reason: Recovered to close down only 0.5% Wed after a 5% midday drop; up 2.1% after hours. No company news.

MU.reason: Closed down 4.5% Wed, halving an 8-9% morning drop; BNP oversupply downgrade and NAND price warnings keep memory-cycle risk high. SK Hynix fell 11% in Seoul.

NFLX.reason: Up 0.9% Wed; defensive relative to AI names, no company news.

NVDA.reason: Closed down 3.9% Wed after a near-9% intraday drop, down 27% in November; S&P put its AA rating on negative watch over governance and key-person risk after the Huang exit and return.

RKT.reason: Up 7.4% Wed on no clear news; a near-certain December hike is a headwind for refinance volumes.

TSM.reason: ADR down 2% Wed; Taipei shares fell 3.6% Wed then rose only 0.2% Thu while the Taiex gained 2.6%. Tariff proposal adds risk.

STRIPE.reason: No new valuation mark or material news since the last run.

OPENAI.reason: No new mark; the $15B raise at a $1.25T valuation is still closing. Anthropic trading below its $83 IPO price this week makes a 2027 OpenAI IPO harder.

headlines: Wed close far better than feared: Nasdaq -0.6% after -4.6% intraday; NVDA -3.9%, MU -4.5%, TSM -2.0%.
S&P put Nvidia's AA rating on negative watch over governance and reliance on Huang.
Core PCE 3.3% vs 3.2% expected; Dec 9 Fed hike odds near 98%.
Rebound names: LDI +18%, RKT +7.4%, FIGR +5.6%, META +3.4%, ENPH +2.4%.
Asia Thu: Hang Seng up about 2%, BABA about +3%; Taiex +2.6% but TSM flat.
US shut Thu for Thanksgiving, half day Fri. Next: ISM and Marvell results Tue Dec 1 = Wed AEDT.
